recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add a Questionnaire.content element or duplicate SDC adaptive mechanics in core; future adaptive Questionnaire endpoint discovery changes should be made in the SDC IG unless a new FHIR-core issue changes base Questionnaire semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17652 was a Published FHIR-core Questionnaire change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for Questionnaire.content-like support so Questionnaires could be returned without items even when they do have items. The accepted resolution did not add a base Questionnaire.content element; it called for SDC adaptive-questionnaire guidance, an SDC adaptive endpoint extension, and trial-use feedback on distinguishing adaptive questionnaires and locating fill-out services.
initial_application: SVN revision 14772, mirrored as git commit b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e, applied FHIR-17652 among Questionnaire changes by adding an Adaptive Questionnaires section to source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml. That text stated that adaptive questionnaires can be active with no questions or an insufficient question set and included a trial-use feedback block. Later commit cd80b481c37dbfdafa7b73995a63020c7ca94753 reorganized the content under the SDC section and pointed to the SDC implementation guide.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini, and source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml still has SDC and Adaptive Questionnaires sections. source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml defines Questionnaire.item as 0..*, so item omission is structurally allowed. Current SDC source defines questionnaireAdaptive and the adaptive questionnaire/search profiles; published SDC issues FHIR-24891 and FHIR-41742 refined the old adaptiveUrl direction into the current extension, endpoint, and $next-question discovery guidance.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core source preserves the applicable FHIR-17652 guidance in build scope, and the endpoint/profile mechanics are external SDC IG content rather than core Questionnaire semantics.

related_jiras.note: Published SDC issue that replaced the earlier adaptiveUrl direction with the current questionnaireAdaptive extension supporting boolean or URL values. It was used as context but not decided because it belongs to FHIR-sdc, not this FHIR-core reconciliation branch.
